summary: ADR-0050 accepted 2026-07-29; formal LKG recovery only via publish_knowledge_catalog.py --restore-lkg; recovery uses single-writer lock and validates LKG pointer, generation identity, hashes, source snapshot, policy, query report, and current main; ancestor LKG allowed only when indexed sources and inputs byte-match main; restores source snapshot, v2 Catalog, projections, and v1 compatibility Catalog, then reruns publication/query/smoke checks; stale LKG cannot override newer main; failed validation or activation rolls back and verifies all prior formal bytes, with current pointer last; publication control-plane scripts must byte-match pinned main; stale-lock recovery rules include PID/process identity, 60-second grace for malformed locks, live/indeterminate owners conflict; pruning is separate explicit prune_knowledge_generations.py --prune; protects current, LKG, and five newest valid successful main-added generations; mtime not authoritative; invalid/uncommitted/unrecognized generations retained and reported; pruning requires canonical policy, persisted intent, per-generation authorization, atomic isolation, and per-target evidence; failure logs append-only outside pruning; extends ADR-0048, complements and does not supersede ADR-0044/0048; retention changes require policy and ADR update
